title: pvANLHaloFinder
body:
## pvANLHaloFinder

Cosmology halo finder from the HACC CosmoTools library (vtkPANLHaloFinder). Input is an unstructured grid of particles with point arrays vx, vy, vz and id, as read by pvGenericIOReader. It links particles closer than Linkinglength (in units of the mean interparticle spacing) into friends-of-friends halos of at least FOFparticlethreshold particles. Port 0 returns the particles with fof_halo_tag (-1 outside halos), port 1 one point per halo with mass, centre of mass, mean velocity, velocity dispersion and centre, and port 2 subhalos when FindSubhalos is on.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Boxsize, Seedparticles and ParticleMass must match the simulation: the interparticle spacing that Linkinglength is measured in is Boxsize / Seedparticles, and the ParaView defaults are example values.
- Positions must lie in [0, Boxsize); others are wrapped periodically.
- Centre finding other than None can be very slow on large halos.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ANLHaloFinder`. Identity: `filters/ANLHaloFinder`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AlphaFactor` | A tuning parameter of subhalo finding. This controls how aggressively small suhalos will be grown. Alpha factor of 1.0 is the least agrressive. Only used if subhalo finding is enabled. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `BetaFactor` | A tuning parameter of subhalo finding. This controls how saddle points between subhalos are treated. Larger values allow identification of smaller scale structures such as tails. Only used if subhalo finding is enabled. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Boxsize` | The box side length used to wrap particles around if they exceed rL (or less than 0) in any dimension (only positive positions are allowed in the input, or they are wrapped around). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `CenterFindingMethod` | Set the method used to determine the halo "center". | `{"type":"enum","values":["None","Most Bound Particle","Most Connected Particle","Hist Center Finding"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"None"` |
| `Deut` | Sets the Deut parameter of the center finding algorithms. This parameter comes from the simulation input and is not needed if Center Finding Method is set to None. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `DistanceConversionFactor` | Some input files may have the world coordinates scaled from what the halo finder expects. This parameter is the conversion factor that will be multiplied by the positions of all particles. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `FOFparticlethreshold` | Minimum number of particles (threshold) needed before a group is called a friends-of-friends (FOF) halo. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `FindSubhalos` | Turn this on to also find subhalos in halos of sufficient size. See the advanced parameters to set subhalo finder options. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Hubble` | Sets the Hubble parameter of the center finding algorithms. This parameter comes from the simulation input and is not needed if Center Finding Method is set to None. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Linkinglength` | Linking length measured in units of interparticle spacing and is dimensionless. Used to link particles into halos for the friends-of-friends (FOF) algorithm. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `MassConversionFactor` | For some inputs the particle mass may need to be converted before the halo finder can be run. This is the number that is multiplied by the particle mass. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MinimumSubhaloSize` | A subhalo candidate must have at least this many particles to be a subhalo. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Minimumsizeforsuhalofinding` | The miminum sized halo to run the subhalo finder of to subdivide further. Only used if subhalo finding is enabled. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `NMin` | The minimum number of close neighbors for a halo candidate to include a particle. If this many particles in the halo are close enough to the particle, then the particle is considered inside the halo. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `NumberofNeighbors` | The nearest X particles will be used to determine the local density in the subhalo finder where X is the value of this parameter. Only used if subhalo finding is enabled. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `OmegaDM` | Sets the OmegaDM parameter of the center finding algorithms. This parameter comes from the simulation input and is not needed if Center Finding Method is set to None. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `OmegaNU` | Sets the OmegaNU parameter of the center finding algorithms. This parameter comes from the simulation input and is not needed if Center Finding Method is set to None. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Overlap` | The space (in rL units) to extend processor particle ownership for ghost particles/cells. Needed for correct halo calculation when halos cross processor boundaries in parallel computation. Called DeadSize in the hacc config files. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `ParticleMass` | The mass of each particle. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `RedShift` | Sets the Redshift parameter of the center finding algorithms. This parameter comes from the simulation input and is not needed if Center Finding Method is set to None. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SPHNeighbors` | A parameter of the subhalo finder. Only used if subhalo finding is enabled. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Seedparticles` | Number of seeded particles in one dimension. Therefore, total simulation particles is np^3 (cubed). | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `SmoothingLength` | Sets the smoothing length used by some of the center finding techniques. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
